criterion: 高流量達門檻觸發送出，低流量未滿但達等待期限仍觸發；背壓時不誤報已交付；Stop 的剩餘批次依專案契約處理。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Capacity or maximum wait triggers a send attempt; refusal preserves pending data. Required finding for the counterexample: A low-rate partial batch waits forever, or refusal is counted as delivery: FLOW-BATCH-001 failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
